title: Thacker Pass Air Pollution Control Permit Notice of Decision — Phase 65 Nevada lithium project delivery review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Nevada lithium project delivery reporting pack. NDEP's air-permit decision records the state authorization milestone for Thacker Pass air emissions subject to the linked permit conditions.
key_findings: It establishes the air-permitting outcome separately from the technical review and final permit.
The decision does not itself demonstrate construction, testing, monitoring, or compliance.
why_it_matters: Which records separate land and environmental authorization, financing, construction, commissioning, compliance, qualification, customer acceptance, and repeat output? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. It completes the provenance chain from technical review to permit decision.
ftfn_relevance: Supports later comparison with testing and monitoring records.
Separates regulatory approval from operating evidence.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
The notice does not establish current permit status or compliance.
It does not prove construction, commissioning, production, or emissions outcomes.
